name: automode
description: Third-party auto mode for Claude Code: a classifier model reviews tool calls that would prompt, and allows, denies, or leaves them to you.

api_key.title: Classifier API key
api_key.description: Stored in secure storage. Leave empty to use AUTOMODE_API_KEY or ~/.claude-automode/config.json

slow_model.title: Classifier model (stage 2, required)
slow_model.description: Model that gives the allow / deny / ask verdict, e.g. deepseek-flash

fast_model.title: Fast filter model (stage 1, optional)
fast_model.description: Cheap model that waves through obviously low-risk calls. Empty = skip stage 1

disable_thinking.title: Send thinking: disabled
disable_thinking.description: For models that think by default (e.g. DeepSeek): adds {"thinking":{"type":"disabled"}} to every request
